input.question: Are there any scientific reasons why male humans are attracted to breasts?
input.ground_truth: You will find that attitudes towards breasts in the western world are quite different from those in other cultures. Our own cultural history surrounding sexuality has pushed us to react differently to them. Many other cultures would consider such an attraction child-like. When discussing human behavior you must never forget that culture plays as large of a role as biology, and that the perspective of your own culture is far from being common across the globe.
